en-US.description: Free and simple software for turning digital photos to the correct orientation
en-US.longDescription: When photos are taken, the camera or phone may be held in different positions, which means some photos need to be rotated to display correctly on the screen. For rotating photos, most image editors decode the JPEG photo, rotate the bitmap and then re-encode it back to JPEG. This process decreases the final image quality. Unlike those tools, JPEG Lossless Rotator does not recode the images and instead performs a special lossless block transformation, which helps to preserve the quality of the images. In addition, JPEG Lossless Rotator has a simple multilingual interface and is very easy to use even for inexperienced computer users.
en-US.name: JPEG Lossless Rotator

zh-CN.description: 免费简单的照片旋转软件，将数字照片调整到正确的方向
zh-CN.longDescription: 拍摄照片时，相机或手机可能处于不同握持方向，这意味着部分照片需要旋转才能正确显示。传统图像编辑器处理旋转时，通常会将 JPEG 照片解码为位图，旋转后重新编码为 JPEG 格式，这种操作会导致画质损耗。而 JPEG Lossless Rotator采用独特的无损区块变换技术，无需重新编码即可实现旋转，完美保留原始画质。该软件还配备简洁的多语言界面，即使电脑新手也能轻松上手使用。
